title: First Day: The Rules
gist_ar: مدير بيشرح لموظف جديد القواعد: إيه اللي لازم، وإيه اللي مش لازم، وإيه المفروض.

before_listening.en: A manager explains the rules on your first day. Listen for the one rule he calls a SAFETY rule.
before_listening.ar: مدير بيشرح القواعد في أول يوم. ركّز على القاعدة اللي قال عليها قاعدة أمان.

segments.speaker: Manager
segments.text: Welcome to the team. Before you start, there are a few things you have to know. You must arrive before eight thirty. If you are going to be late, you have to call your manager, not a colleague. You don't have to wear a suit, but you should wear something clean and simple. You must not use your phone on the factory floor. That is a safety rule, not a suggestion. You should ask questions in your first week. Nobody expects you to know everything, and it is much better to ask than to guess. If a machine sounds strange, you must stop it and tell someone immediately. You have to take your break between one and two, and you should eat something, because people who skip lunch make more mistakes in the afternoon. Good luck.

gist_question.q: Which rule does the manager call a safety rule?
gist_question.q_ar: أنهي قاعدة قال عليها المدير إنها قاعدة أمان؟
options: Not using your phone on the factory floor
Taking your break between one and two

questions.q: Who must you call if you are going to be late?
What does he say about clothes?
options: You don't have to wear a suit, but wear something clean and simple
Clothes are not important at all

questions.q: What must you do if a machine sounds strange?
questions.q_ar: تعمل إيه لو ماكينة صوتها غريب؟
options: Stop it and tell someone immediately
